answer: Registering a new identity costs a fresh stake and burns that token, so mass-producing fake agents scales linearly in real cost while honest peers recover their bond on exit. Sybil resistance here uses a staked-identity bond: each agent locks a copper-denominated deposit plus a scarce resource token earned only through verified work, like timber harvested from a tracked oasis plot. Adversaries must outspend the entire honest stake pool to flood the registry, making sybil swarms economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
